# Export scripts of the TextBlockExporter PNG tests. The language is the
# one of cases.txt; "export format PNG" is implied. png_test.go runs them
# with this package, and internal/klimt/g2d/testdata/javagen/G2dGolden.java
# with upstream's TextBlockExporter, which writes golden-png/<case>.png and
# golden-png/imagedata.txt (image data, then the PNG width and height).

case basic
export format PNG
color #181818
bg #FEFECE
rect 80 30 5
translate 10 25
text SansSerif 12 plain - #000000 - - 0 basic
write @startuml\nA\s->\sB\s:\shello\n@enduml

case no-metadata
export format PNG
color #181818
rect 80 30
write

case unicode-metadata
export format PNG
color #181818
rect 20 20
write @startuml\nAlice\s->\sBob\s:\sпривет\s→\s日本\n@enduml

case margins
export format PNG
export margin 10 20 30 40
export dim 60.5 20.25
color #181818
rect 60.5 20.25
write

case dpi72
export format PNG
export skinparam dpi 72
export dim 100.5 50.25
color #181818
bg #FEFECE
rect 80 30 5 3
translate 10 25
text SansSerif 12 plain - #000000 - - 0 dpi\s72
write

case dpi96
export format PNG
export skinparam dpi 96
export dim 100.5 50.25
color #181818
bg #FEFECE
rect 80 30 5 3
translate 10 25
text SansSerif 12 plain - #000000 - - 0 dpi\s96
write

case dpi120
export format PNG
export skinparam dpi 120
export dim 100.5 50.25
color #181818
bg #FEFECE
rect 80 30 5 3
translate 10 25
text SansSerif 12 plain - #000000 - - 0 dpi\s120
write

case dpi150
export format PNG
export skinparam dpi 150
export dim 100.5 50.25
color #181818
bg #FEFECE
rect 80 30 5 3
translate 10 25
text SansSerif 12 plain - #000000 - - 0 dpi\s150
write

case dpi192
export format PNG
export skinparam dpi 192
export dim 100.5 50.25
color #181818
bg #FEFECE
rect 80 30 5 3
translate 10 25
text SansSerif 12 plain - #000000 - - 0 dpi\s192
write

case dpi300
export format PNG
export skinparam dpi 300
export dim 100.5 50.25
color #181818
bg #FEFECE
rect 80 30 5 3
translate 10 25
text SansSerif 12 plain - #000000 - - 0 dpi\s300
write

case scale-simple
export format PNG
export scale simple 2
color #181818
bg #FEFECE
rect 20 10 3
translate 5 30
text SansSerif 12 plain - #000000 - - 0 scaled
write

case scale-width
export format PNG
export scale width 300
color #181818
rect 20 10
write

case backcolor
export format PNG
export back #FEFECE
color #181818
rect 10 10
write

case backcolor-transparent
export format PNG
export back transparent
color #181818
bg #FEFECE
rect 40 20 5
write

case backcolor-gradient
export format PNG
export back #FFFFFF/#AAAAFF
color #181818
rect 10 10
write

case textblock-backcolor
export format PNG
export tbback #FF0000
color #181818
rect 10 10
write

case border
export format PNG
export skinparam diagramBorderColor #FF0000
export skinparam diagramBorderThickness 2
color #181818
rect 10 10
write

case mapper-dark
export format PNG
export ffo mapper dark
color #181818
bg #FEFECE
rect 40 20 5
translate 5 35
text SansSerif 12 plain - #000000 - - 0 dark
write

case png-empty
export format PNG_EMPTY
color #181818
rect 10 10
write

case limit
export format PNG
export dim 5000 60
color #181818
bg #FEFECE
rect 4990 50
translate 4000 30
text SansSerif 12 plain - #000000 - - 0 clipped\sat\s4096
write

case links
export format PNG
export dim 120 60
url https://example.com tooltip
color #181818
bg #FEFECE
rect 50 30
endurl
url javascript:alert(1)
translate 60 0
rect 50 30
endurl
write

case watermark
export format PNG
export ffo watermark Confidential\sdraft
export dim 200 80
color #181818
rect 20 20
write
